    SMA_PERIOD = 20
    RSI_PERIOD = 14

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            self.RSI_PERIOD,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.strategy_a_order = None
        self.strategy_b_order = None

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return
            bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

        current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        current_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady else None

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
        aapl_rsi_ready = self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

        spy_crosses_above = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_crosses_below = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

            aapl_rsi_ready
            and self.previous_aapl_rsi is not None
            and self.previous_aapl_rsi <= 60
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        )

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.strategy_a_order is None:
            if spy_crosses_below:
                self.strategy_a_order = self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    -self.strategy_a_lot,
                    tag="Strategy A liquidation"
                )

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.strategy_b_order is None:
            if aapl_sell_signal:
                self.strategy_b_order = self.MarketOrder(
                    self.aapl,
                    -self.strategy_b_lot,
                    tag="Strategy B liquidation"
                )

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.strategy_a_order is None
            and spy_crosses_above
        ):
            quantity = int(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.strategy_a_order = self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    quantity,
                    tag="Strategy A buy"
                )

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and self.strategy_b_order is None
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        ):
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.strategy_b_order = self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        quantity,
                        tag="Strategy B buy"
                    )

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if spy_sma_ready else None
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value if aapl_rsi_ready else None

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status not in [
            OrderStatus.Filled,
            OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled,
            OrderStatus.Canceled,
            OrderStatus.Invalid,
            OrderStatus.Rejected
        ]:
            return

        order_id = orderEvent.OrderId
        fill_quantity = orderEvent.FillQuantity

        if self.strategy_a_order is not None and order_id == self.strategy_a_order.OrderId:
            self.strategy_a_lot += fill_quantity

            if orderEvent.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.Rejected
            ]:
                if self.strategy_a_lot < 0:
                    self.strategy_a_lot = 0
                self.strategy_a_order = None

        elif self.strategy_b_order is not None and order_id == self.strategy_b_order.OrderId:
            self.strategy_b_lot += fill_quantity

            if orderEvent.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.Rejected
            ]:
                if self.strategy_b_lot < 0:
                    self.strategy_b_lot = 0
                self.strategy_b_order = None
